Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the testing procedures 
P1 for SD35a distance relay, which must be performed on an annually bases Y1 as 
indicated in the title block.
The first draft initiated by 
eng. 
Abdel Raheem Salem Mohamed Ez, 
tested by eng. Khaled El-Etreby & eng. Atef Farh, revised by 
quality control eng. Tawfik Elabasery at EDEPCo.,
and approved by eng. Monear Mahmoud El-Wakeel: Head Sector of 
 Damietta 
Power Station.
Safety Precautions
A work 
permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
suitable safety category,
Safety 
fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Line Isolation
Make sure CT secondary circuits are 
shorted.
Voltage Supply to the relay may be alive 
even after the line is isolated.
Isolate DC supply to relay, when doing any 
adjustments or maintenance on the relay itself
Ensure all CT path elements are secure 
after any test disturbance.
Tools and Equipment
Test set Siemens 
 type 
 7VP48 & 7VP49,
Ammeter, Phase 
 rotation meter ,
Small slot 
 screwdriver, test leads,
Clip-on ammeter 
 (optional) .
Work to be Carried Out
The line is out of service
Disconnect the miniature circuit breaker 
 (m.c.b) for the potential transformer PT
Connect the link of current terminal 
 F-X2 (47, 48, 49) (move the link up)
Disconnect the voltage terminal F-X2 
 (61, 71, 81, 91)
Connect the voltage leads UR, 
 US, UT, UN to terminal F-X1 (61, 
 71, 81, 91)
Connect the current leads IR, 
 IN to terminal A-X1(44,12)
Inject 3phase voltage U1 = 100 & 
 1phase current
Inject 100V voltage and determine the 
 P.U. value of current and measure the time (402, 502) (spare contact).
Inject the I P.U. and determine the 
 operating voltage at the angles (0.09-180-270)
Repeat the previous steps for Is, In 
 (44,22) and It, In (44,32)
Connect the voltage terminal F-X1 
 (61,71,81,91) & connect the miniature circuit breaker (m.c.b) for the 
 potential transformer and move the link of terminal (47,48,49) down
